method: Each listed record was individually read through the source/example/policy/five-case --audit output. All declared frames and five six-person paradigms were read; representative generated ordinary and formal contexts are explicitly listed. Hashes bind the exact data and output reviewed, but do not turn unlisted contexts into linguistic review. The recorded range has been read without gaps; truncated batches were reread in smaller ranges. This is an author-agent audit, not an independent or native-human pass. Findings remain open unless they describe an explicitly completed bounded repair.
